name: Energy, Utilities & Mining Domain Practices
description: Exhaustive business-domain knowledge pack for Energy, Electric/Gas Utilities, Mining, and Oil & Gas, covering Smart Meter Data Management (MDM), utility tariff billing, Outage Management Systems (OMS), field service dispatch, energy trading, mine production planning, ore tracking, and pipeline asset management.
owner: Global Energy, Utilities & Mining Operations Office

checklists.name: Energy, Utilities & Mining Audit Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for smart meter data processing, TOU utility billing, OMS crew dispatch, and pipeline safety.

items.statement: Smart Meter Data Management (MDM) validates 15-minute interval consumption data for billing anomalies.
Utility billing engines calculate Time-Of-Use (TOU) rates, demand charges, and local regulatory taxes.
Outage Management Systems (OMS) pinpoint grid faults using smart meter ping responses and customer calls.
Mining ore tracking measures grade quality and tonnage at processing plant intake points.
SCADA pipeline sensors monitor pressure and temperature thresholds with automated emergency isolation valves.

reviewGates.name: Energy & Utilities Operations Director Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Utilities Operations Director confirms that AMI meter billing, OMS grid restoration, and SCADA safety controls comply with regulatory mandates.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the utility documentation confirm meter billing accuracy and grid safety compliance?
